title: Bayar macam mana?
blurb: Paying up: cash, card or QR, and what to do when you're three ringgit short.

notes.title: cash, kad, QR
notes.body: Small shops and stalls take cash or QR (DuitNow / e-wallet); many don't take kad. Scan sini — scan here.

notes.title: baki and duit kecik
notes.body: Baki = change (what's left). Duit kecik or duit pecah = small change. Takde duit kecik — no small notes.

notes.title: Semua sekali
notes.body: Semua sekali = all together: Semua sekali berapa? — how much for everything?

tr.Ada lagi. Nak berapa kilo?: There's still some. How many kilos do you want?
tr.Apa kau nak beli?: What do you want to buy?
It only came in this morning.
tr.Biru je ada. Nak cuba?: There's only blue. Want to try them?
Okay then, I'll try them first.
tr.Boleh saya tinggal satu barang?: Can I leave one item behind?
tr.Cili nak berapa?: How much chilli do you want?
tr.Dua puluh lima lah. Ini je yang saya ada: Twenty-five, come on. That's all I have.
Sixty-five, come on. I can't afford more.
tr.Hitam habis. Nak warna lain?: Black is sold out. Want another colour?
tr.Kecik sikit. Ada saiz besar?: A bit small. Do you have a bigger size?
tr.Kembung sekilo lima belas. Nak berapa?: Mackerel is fifteen a kilo. How much do you want?
tr.Kurang tiga ringgit. Macam mana?: You're three ringgit short. What now?
tr.Lima puluh. Ada baki?: A fifty. Do you have change?
tr.Mahal lah. Kurang sikit boleh?: That's expensive. Can it be a bit less?
tr.Mahal lah. Lima belas boleh?: That's expensive. Can you do fifteen?
tr.Mahal sangat. Kedai sebelah jual enam pu: Too expensive. The shop next door sells them for sixty.
tr.Mesin kad rosak. Cash ada?: The card machine is broken. Do you have cash?
I want to buy a few grapes.
tr.Nak beli berapa?: How many do you want to buy?
tr.Nak plastik?: Do you want a plastic bag?
It'd be a loss not to buy.
Just half a kilo. Please clean them too.
tr.Stok baru sampai minggu depan. Nak tungg: New stock arrives next week. Do you want to wait?
tr.Tak cukup. QR boleh?: Not enough. Can I pay by QR?
Don't you want to buy? It's cheap.
No need. I have a bag.
tr.Yang hijau dua belas, yang merah lima be: The green ones are twelve, the red ones fifteen. Which do you want?
The green ones. They're a bit cheaper.
Eighty ringgit. It's the original product.

dialogue.ms: Sila bayar di sini.
dialogue.en: Please pay here.

dialogue.ms: Berapa semua?
dialogue.en: How much is everything?

dialogue.ms: Dua puluh ringgit.
dialogue.en: Twenty ringgit.

dialogue.ms: Bayar cash boleh?
dialogue.en: Can I pay cash?

dialogue.ms: Boleh.
dialogue.en: Yes.

dialogue.ms: Nah. Terima kasih.
dialogue.en: Here you go. Thank you.

read.why: Cash or card? Choose one, and hand it over: nah.

read.ms: Kedai ini tidak membuka hari ini.

dialogue.ms: Semua sekali tiga puluh dua ringgit.
dialogue.en: Thirty-two ringgit altogether.

dialogue.ms: Bolehkah saya bayar dengan kad kredit?
dialogue.en: Can I pay by credit card?

dialogue.ms: Kad tak boleh. Cash ke QR je.
dialogue.en: No cards. Cash or QR only.

dialogue.ms: Okay, cash lah. Lima puluh, ada baki?
dialogue.en: Okay, cash then. A fifty — do you have change?

dialogue.ms: Saya tiada duit pecah.
dialogue.en: I don't have any small change.

dialogue.ms: Kalau macam tu, saya scan QR.
dialogue.en: In that case, I'll scan the QR.

dialogue.ms: Okay, scan sini. Dah masuk?
dialogue.en: Okay, scan here. Has it gone through?

dialogue.ms: Dah. Terima kasih, kak.
dialogue.en: Yes. Thank you.

gist.q: Why does he end up paying by QR?
options: She has no change for his fifty
gist.why: Saya tiada duit pecah … saya scan QR.

read.why: Asked for change: takde duit kecik — no small notes.

read.en: Do you have money or not?

read.why: Has the payment gone through? Dah, and the amount.

read.en: Please give me back my money.

dialogue.ms: Semua sekali empat puluh tiga ringgit.
dialogue.en: Forty-three ringgit altogether.

dialogue.ms: Bolehkah saya bayar dengan kad kredit?
dialogue.en: Can I pay by credit card?

dialogue.ms: Kad tak boleh lah. Mesin rosak. Cash ke QR je.
dialogue.en: No cards, sorry. The machine's broken. Cash or QR only.

dialogue.ms: Saya terlupa duit saya. QR lah.
dialogue.en: I forgot my money. QR, then.

dialogue.ms: Okay, scan sini.
dialogue.en: Okay, scan here.

dialogue.ms: Eh, internet slow. Tak boleh scan.
dialogue.en: Oh, the internet's slow. I can't scan.

dialogue.ms: Cuba lagi sekali.
dialogue.en: Try once more.

dialogue.ms: Tak boleh jugak. Kejap, saya cari cash. Ini je duit aku ada.
dialogue.en: Still can't. Hang on, I'll look for cash. This is all the money I have.

dialogue.ms: Empat puluh je? Kurang tiga ringgit.
dialogue.en: Only forty? You're three ringgit short.

dialogue.ms: Alamak. Boleh saya tinggal satu barang?
dialogue.en: Oh no. Can I leave one item behind?

dialogue.ms: Takpe lah, tiga ringgit je. Lain kali bayar.
dialogue.en: Never mind, it's only three ringgit. Pay next time.

dialogue.ms: Betul ke? Terima kasih banyak, kak!
dialogue.en: Really? Thank you so much!

gist.q: How is the missing three ringgit settled?
options: She lets him pay it next time
He pays by card after all
He borrows it from a friend
gist.why: Takpe lah, tiga ringgit je. Lain kali bayar.

listen.ms: Dah tau takde duit, nak beli jugak.
listen.en: Knows there's no money, and still wants to buy.
wrong: Has plenty of money but won't buy.
Bought it because it was cheap.
Didn't know the price before buying.

listen.en: He doesn't have very much money.
wrong: He has far too much money.

listen.ms: Bukan macam sekarang, semua benda mahal.
listen.en: Not like now, when everything is expensive.

read.why: Short of money: offer to leave one item.
Not enough cash: tak cukup — and ask about QR.
